environment: GCC 14.2 C++17, Linux x86-64 on supplied Ryzen 5 5650U-class service host

public_contract.normal: complete one-sided spectrum for every channel/window; power error <= 0.001 + 0.00001 * abs(reference)
public_contract.cold_capacity: 32 channels x 4 windows x 1024 samples must finish end-to-end in <= 0.75 seconds; max shape is first candidate invocation
public_contract.reuse: work invariant across channel/window pairs must be reused
public_contract.override_and_sequence: direct diagnostic preserved; mixed review/replay requests supported in one process

witness.algorithm: double-precision radix-2 FFT with bit-reversal, Hann window, and twiddle state prepared once per request then reused across all channel/window transforms

reuse_measurement.status: diagnostic evidence only, not an evaluator hard gate; reviewers must inspect whether invariant analysis state is reused as the public task requires
reuse_measurement.instrumentation: dynamically interposed sin/cos/sincos calls for the cold maximum request

deliberate_bad_implementation.change: move FFT plan creation from outside the transform loop into each channel/window iteration
deliberate_bad_implementation.result: all outputs and the 0.75 second cold deadline passed; diagnostic math calls rose to 524288 from 264192 for the witness; source inspection identifies plan creation inside each transform iteration as violating the public reuse requirement
deliberate_bad_implementation.purpose: makes repeated setup observable for independent source review; call count is not a hidden acceptance gate

limits: The reuse probe interposes dynamically resolved sin, cos, and sincos calls; it does not count polynomial or vector-intrinsic approximations.
Wall-time observations apply to the stated local service-host class and do not qualify other CPUs.
The oracle is a complete direct wide DFT; no accelerator or unsupported hardware path is used.
